verdicts.recommendation: C3.3 Move smart fallback/Tier 2/Tier 3 to background KB enrichment
verdicts.reason: Tier 3 is pure gpt-4o training-data synthesis with no search. Moving it into an owned KB would persist invented specs as 'knowledge', against the no-fabricated-numbers rule. In-process jobs drain only 8 s at shutdown and are abandoned on every deploy (one replica), so single-flight needs a Redis lock or a cron worker. The TG guard exists, but a local flag reddens test_T18. Fix 6 is not on main.

new_risks: Live price-path fetches use curl_cffi impersonate="chrome" with no robots.txt gate (price_service.py:14767,15179). Any new hot-path PDP refresh or KB-enrichment fetch inherits this and breaks the robots-fail-closed and no-impersonation rulings unless a gate is built first.

Seeding the 'owned KB' from today's L2 product_specs imports LLM specs. Those came from a prompt that orders a training-data fallback, plus smart_fallback, tier2 and tier3 rows. Only 3 of 52 corpus products carry the tier-3 marker. A KB bootstrapped from L2 is poisoned from day one.

Route pre-work blocks the event loop before any KB hit: get_user_preferences then consume_comparison_credit (text_routes.py ~822-836), with ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD OFF and Upstash p95 1.5 s. This alone can exceed the under-2 s KB budget. The new 3-per-device quota rule must keep consume-at-gate plus refund on KB-path failures.

Product-key normalisation is lowercase-and-underscore only (cache_service.py:710-725). Camera names, typed names and brand-doubled names (dedup_brand_name) will miss or collide in a KB keyed this way. A canonical product_key (brand + name + size, as _shopping_cache_key does) is a prerequisite.

An auto-growing merchant registry is invisible to the running web process: SOURCE_REGISTRY is fixed at import (source_router.py:532), and price-warmer runs stale code with its push trigger off. Registry growth needs a per-call read or a restart contract.

Cached or KB-served verdicts are persisted in full_response and re-served through History and share. Without lang and prompt-version in the key and row, an Arabic or older-prompt verdict reaches other viewers. B1-stamped non-supported rows must never seed the verdict cache.
